edition.title: The Ante-Nicene Fathers, Volume III: Latin Christianity: Its Founder, Tertullian

work.author: Alexander Roberts, James Donaldson, and A. Cleveland Coxe
work.description: The third volume of the American Ante-Nicene Fathers translation anthology, containing the apologetic, anti-Marcionite, and ethical works of Tertullian in nineteenth-century English translation. Its container identity remains distinct from Tertullian's Latin works and from the translated editions printed within it.
work.title: The Ante-Nicene Fathers, Volume III
